Im Jahr 2008 kam es zu einer angeblichen UFO-Sichtung in Stephenville in Texas. Craig und Sara reden in dieser Episode mit Augenzeugen des Vorfalls und untersuchen eine mögliche Vertuschung vonseiten des Militärs.

Wir lernen über die Aufgabenbereiche der Bundespolizei: zum Beispiel den Grenz- und Küstenschutz mit dem Einsatzschiff BP82 Bamberg, den Einsatz von Spezialkräften sowie die Aufgaben der Bundespolizeidirektion Flughafen Frankfurt am Main.
pr.sub: Die Bundespolizei - Zu Wasser, zu Lande und in der Luft

pr.d: Die Bundespolizei wird auf verschiedene Einsätze begleitet, um deren breit gefächerten Arbeitsbereiche kennenzulernen. Von Schutz am Flughafen bis hin zur Beweissicherungs- und Festnahmeeinheit wird der Alltag der Bundespolizei beleuchtet.

Die Correctional Institution for Women ist das älteste und größte Frauengefängnis auf den Philippinen. Die Bandbreite der Inhaftierten reicht von Kleinkriminellen bis hin zu Mörderinnen und Gangmitgliedern, die häufig aus dem Großraum Manila kommen.

In der von Armut und Arbeitslosigkeit geprägten Stadt Zenica liegt das größte und härteste Gefängnis von Bosnien. Seit vielen Jahren konkurrieren Katholiken, Orthodoxe und Muslime vor Ort um die Macht. Zenica gleicht daher einem Pulverfass.

In der Hauptstadt Manila befindet sich das größte Frauengefängnis der Philippinen. Die Großstadt ist von Armut gezeichnet, und viele Schicksale enden in der Kriminalität. Die häufigsten Vergehen sind Betrug, Prostitution und Drogen.

Der Zoll am Flughafen Atlanta findet im Gepäck eines angeblichen Partyveranstalters fast zwei Kilo der Vergewaltigungsdroge GBL. Am San Francisco International Airport macht sich ein Besucher des Burning-Man-Festivals mit zahlreichen Pillen.

In Honolulu gerät eine Frau ins Visier, die sich womöglich illegal in den USA niederlassen will. Noch brisanter ist: Ein herrenloser Koffer entpuppt sich als Drogendepot. Im Frachtterminal stoßen die Beamten auf eine perfide Schmuggelmethode.

pr.t: Vom Rind zum Steak - Europas größter Rinder-Schlachthof
pr.d: Täglich werden in Europas größtem Rinder-Schlachthof in Waldkraiburg circa tausend Rinder geschlachtet und weiterverarbeitet. Jedes Exemplar wird bewertet. Bei der Fleischverarbeitung wird ein strenger Produktionsablauf eingehalten.

Pro Kopf verzehrt der Deutsche 38,1 Kilogramm Schweinefleisch im Jahr. Die Dokumentation zeigt den Weg des Nahrungsmittels vom Tier bis auf den Teller. Ein Gutshof in Bayern setzt auf glückliche Tiere, Bio und Handarbeit.
pr.sub: Vom Schwein zum Schnitzel - Hinter den Kulissen der Fleischindustrie

pr.d: Der Burger ist ein beliebter Imbiss. Mittlerweile dringen immer mehr inhabergeführte Restaurants auf den Markt. Wie sieht es hinter den Bedientheken in deutschen Burger-Läden aus? Welches Geschäftsmodell überzeugt: Massenware oder Handarbeit?

Die moderne Küche soll schick, modern und repräsentativ sein. Dabei sind die Grundzüge der verschiedenen im Handel erhältlichen Modelle gleichermaßen einander ähnlich wie simpel. Küchen werden aus mehreren Schranktypen und E-Geräten zusammengestellt.
pr.sub: Die Küchenmacher - Von Maßarbeit bis Massenware

pr.d: Moderne Landwirtschaft ist ohne sie undenkbar: riesige Erntemaschinen. Die Reportage sieht sich auf der Messe "Agritechnica" um, ist bei einem Ernteeinsatz in Vorpommern dabei und zeigt, mit welchem Aufwand die Maschinen transportiert werden.

Witness once-in-a-lifetime scenes, from a buffalo chase to a lion cub's race against time. Emotions run high as safari drama is up close and personal.

The Schroeders and their staff head west to round up hundreds of cows.
In China's leading giant panda centre, cute cubs tackle some essential life skills, from how to chew bamboo to the art of keeping your balance up a tree.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
The children have adopted a new pet, a dragon named Dave. They did not know that he was going to grow and grow though and need to find him a place where he belongs.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.
Percy takes a game of superheroes and villains too far and hurts his friends' feelings, accidentally becoming Sodor's best bad guy.
Paddington seeks the mystery hero doing good deeds, Paddington gets stuck in an igloo.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Unlikely Hero / Paddington Needs a Hero

pr.d: Paddington tries to find out who his favourite hero is, so he sets out with Judy. Paddington really wants to participate in a skating competition, but he can't. Until Mateo gives him a helping hand with a magical mask.
pr.sub: Paddington's Favourite Hero; Paddington and the Skateboarder

pr.d: It's Halloween, but will a curse on the theatre stop the community putting on their show? Taylor the lifeguard arrives in Windsor Gardens, and just in time to save the Mooncake festival with Paddington.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Cursed Halloween Show; Paddington Saves the Mooncake Festival

pr.d: It's Taylor's birthday, but he hasn't told anyone. Tom comes up with a white lie and says she has a very special gift for him. On the Scottish holiday 'Burns Night' the legend 'Haggis' walks around, and Paddington is eager to see one.
pr.sub: Paddington's Birthday Gift Hunt; Paddington's Burn's Night Haggis Hunt

pr.d: Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
Alex and his Mini-Patrol accidentally take off on Daring Danny's rocket bike.
pr.sub: Pups Save an Out of Control Mini Patrol

pr.d: Pups and the Werepuppy: Rocky goes missing at Uncle Otis's cabin in the woods and the PAW Patrol needs to solve the mystery of the Werepuppy.

It's Earth Day and Paddington has the important job of planting a tree. He has to find the perfect spot before it is too late. Baaz holds a spring harvest festival and everyone enjoys bringing their own celebration along.
pr.sub: Paddington's Earth Day Mission; Paddington's Special Spring Harvest Celebration

pr.d: Who is Paddington's Special Visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle, how can another be found in time?
pr.sub: Paddington's Special Visitor; Paddington Celebrates Hanukkah

pr.d: Paddington takes off and becomes the world's first Bearonaut; Jonathan, Judy, and Paddington pick all the blackberries in the garden, but Mr. Curry seems to think some are his.
pr.sub: Paddington's Space Adventure; Paddington's Blackberry Adventure

pr.d: The children are playing a game of superheroes. When Strawberry takes her super villain role a bit too far, it is up to the 'Elf Man' and 'Fairy Girl' to save the day.
Lucy celebrates her birthday with an Elf and Fairy party and Ben, Holly and friends are invited.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.
pr.sub: The Crew Builds an Underwater Shell Museum; The Crew Builds a Giant Shoe Store

pr.d: At the Farm Fair, a mysterious critter chews up everything in sight, and the pups must save the day! Later, Rocky dreams a sudsy accident turns Adventure Bay into a giant bubble bath, putting everyone at risk!
pr.sub: Pups Save the Farm Festival; Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay!

pr.d: The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom / The Pups have to save ancient relics when high jinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Splashy Bottom; Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide

pr.d: Tim and Dad have to catch a troublesome mole.
When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia cannot decide on what the best gift could be for their grandmother.
AJ, and Stripes test their explorer skills as they follow the trail to the fabled Tiger Treasure.
While completing an obstacle course to become superheroes, Gabby and Pandy learn how to use their bodies as well as their minds.
Nanny Plum is teaching the fairy girls some important fairy rules when she is blown away, trapped in a tree, dropped in a stream and covered in mud.
Lucy and her dad are having a relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake, but it belongs to a mermaid who would like it back.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Smurfette and Grouchy compete to determine who is the best. Blossom dreams of travelling to Mars and can rely on her friends for support.
pr.sub: The Battle of the Sitters; Let's Smurf to Mars

pr.d: When Mayor Goodway and the twins are late getting back from snowshoeing, Jake and Everest call the PAW Patrol to search for them. When water in the duck pond mysteriously drains out, it is up to the PAW Patrol to find out what's happening.
pr.sub: Pups Save the Snowshoeing Goodways; Pups Save a Duck Pond

pr.d: Uncle Otis takes a trip to goldmine; Uncle Otis installs a Smart Home 3000 in his cabin that ends up trapping him and Mr. Wingnut inside.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Lost Gold Miner; Pups Save Uncle Otis From His Cabin

pr.d: It's the Chahuta's chilli eating contest, and soon it's revealed Marcel's a cheat. When Hope takes Gran Gran's special ladle to the park to play, it ends up at Professor Lopez's archaeological dig.
pr.sub: The Heat is on / Dig disaster

pr.d: Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow.

Everyone is visiting snooty King and Queen Marigold's Castle. King and Queen Marigold give them a tour which features a room made of ice sculptures and an upside down room. However, the tour is not without a few mishaps.
Queen Thistle reads the children a story, which inspires a question. They can't find the answer in the magic books in the castle, so they go to the Wise Old Elf in the Great Elf Library.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim, Kai and Tommy try to get their ball back from Mum's bedroom.
Tim and Kai attempt to take a photograph of the elusive SpaceBug.
It's the Roar festival, and Tim wants to have the best Roar in town.
Beach shoes have gone missing. Some red hair is found at the scene and Grumblestunk is blaming Stan! Who really did it!? Stan and Gran spy a mystery!
Sand! Sea! Worms! Stan and Gran must quickly discover where all these worms came from or Ellie's new clothes drying service will be ruined!

The evil witch Caemwyn returns to take over the clinic and steal its magic, so Clarion and Annette must rely on their veterinary knowledge to defend the facility together, where they confidently work as a team to protect their home and its pets.
pr.sub: The Return of Caemwyn / Out Of The Shadows

On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.

Holly accidentally turns Ben into a frog. With the help of her friends, Holly tries to turn Ben back into an elf but instead turns him into a bird and then a rabbit.

Lucy and her dad are having a relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake, but it belongs to a mermaid who would like it back.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Smurfette and Grouchy compete to determine who is the best. Blossom dreams of travelling to Mars and can rely on her friends for support.
pr.sub: The Battle of the Sitters; Let's Smurf to Mars

pr.d: When Mayor Goodway and the twins are late getting back from snowshoeing, Jake and Everest call the PAW Patrol to search for them. When water in the duck pond mysteriously drains out, it is up to the PAW Patrol to find out what's happening.
pr.sub: Pups Save the Snowshoeing Goodways; Pups Save a Duck Pond

pr.d: Uncle Otis takes a trip to goldmine; Uncle Otis installs a Smart Home 3000 in his cabin that ends up trapping him and Mr. Wingnut inside.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Lost Gold Miner; Pups Save Uncle Otis From His Cabin

pr.d: It's the Chahuta's chilli eating contest, and soon it's revealed Marcel's a cheat. When Hope takes Gran Gran's special ladle to the park to play, it ends up at Professor Lopez's archaeological dig.
pr.sub: The Heat is on / Dig disaster

pr.d: Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow.

Everyone is visiting snooty King and Queen Marigold's Castle. King and Queen Marigold give them a tour which features a room made of ice sculptures and an upside down room. However, the tour is not without a few mishaps.
Queen Thistle reads the children a story, which inspires a question. They can't find the answer in the magic books in the castle, so they go to the Wise Old Elf in the Great Elf Library.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim, Kai and Tommy try to get their ball back from Mum's bedroom.
Tim and Kai attempt to take a photograph of the elusive SpaceBug.
It's the Roar festival, and Tim wants to have the best Roar in town.
Beach shoes have gone missing. Some red hair is found at the scene and Grumblestunk is blaming Stan! Who really did it!? Stan and Gran spy a mystery!
Sand! Sea! Worms! Stan and Gran must quickly discover where all these worms came from or Ellie's new clothes drying service will be ruined!

The evil witch Caemwyn returns to take over the clinic and steal its magic, so Clarion and Annette must rely on their veterinary knowledge to defend the facility together, where they confidently work as a team to protect their home and its pets.
pr.sub: The Return of Caemwyn / Out Of The Shadows

pr.d: Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.
pr.sub: The Crew Builds an Underwater Shell Museum; The Crew Builds a Giant Shoe Store

pr.d: At the Farm Fair, a mysterious critter chews up everything in sight, and the pups must save the day! Later, Rocky dreams a sudsy accident turns Adventure Bay into a giant bubble bath, putting everyone at risk!
pr.sub: Pups Save the Farm Festival; Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay!

pr.d: The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom / The Pups have to save ancient relics when high jinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Splashy Bottom; Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide

pr.d: Francois encounters a problem while directing a video for Mr Porter. The Super Farm Fair takes a strange turn as Mooo-na Lisa and Bettina run away with their superhero costumes on.
pr.sub: Pups Save the Director; Pups Save the Super Cows

pr.d: It's CatRat's birthday! Help Gabby and the gang plan a super-secret surprise party for their feline friend and his very special guest, Fluffy Flufferton.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
King Thistle does not want to get any older so decides that no one must celebrate his birthday, but all the Little Kingdom has been waiting to celebrate.
Holly accidentally turns Ben into a frog. With the help of her friends, Holly tries to turn Ben back into an elf but instead turns him into a bird and then a rabbit.
When water lines break all over Sodor, the engines chug into action to deliver repair parts, but the problem needs off-track thinking and help from Skiff and Terence.
When Thomas' carelessness leads to Boxy being broken beyond repair, Thomas must confront his own behaviour.
Beach shoes have gone missing. Some red hair is found at the scene and Grumblestunk is blaming Stan! Who really did it!? Stan and Gran spy a mystery!
Sand! Sea! Worms! Stan and Gran must quickly discover where all these worms came from or Ellie's new clothes drying service will be ruined!
Tim, Tommy, and Tia cannot decide on what the best gift could be for their grandmother.
Tim and Kai compete in a Star Hunt through Rumbleton.
Tim makes an attempt at creating his very own Captain DinoStar movie.

Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Solar Eclipse; Paddington and the Mysterious Inventor

pr.d: With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold invite themselves round for dinner to King and Queen Thistle's Castle to sample Nanny Plum's cooking. Nanny tries very hard to cook special modern food.
Things are going missing all over the Little Kingdom - Holly has lost her wand and Ben has lost his horn! Soon they realise that ants are stealing their things.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
pr.sub: The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World

pr.d: Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her family are playing at the pond with their toy boats, but when Peppa and George's friends arrive, everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.
It's a very cold winter's day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play, but all the puddles have frozen over, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.
George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
pr.sub: Mr. Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz

pr.d: Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Peppa and her friends are busy building a desert island in a sandpit. They are all very proud of it, with its forest, lake, houses and shops. It's going splendidly, until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa teases George because he can't catch a ball properly. Mummy Pig suggests they play a game that will help George learn how to catch, called 'Piggy in the Middle'.
It is Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.
Baby Alexander is too young to talk until Peppa teaches him his first word.
Peppa and George realise that they have shadows and no matter what they do, they can't escape from them.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Peppa wins her first star for making a wonderful drawing of her house. Dad realises that he has never won a single star and is determined to solve the problem.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle. The family soon realise that her house is being pushed over by the tall tree next to it. Mr. Bull arrives and with his help they all manage to save Madame Gazelle's House and tree.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.
When Peppa and George go to the dentist for a check-up, Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white, but George's toy dinosaur is in need of a tooth clean.
Oh dear, Miss Rabbit's train has broken down and all her passengers need to get to work. So Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train, Gertrude.
pr.sub: Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue

pr.d: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.

What's that strange creature hovering in the sky? It's George's dinosaur balloon, but little George is finding it difficult to keep hold of his big balloon. Can anyone stop it from flying off to the moon?
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.
Peppa and family are at the school fair where the top prize in the raffle is a hot-air balloon ride.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
The children's favourite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving Playgroup. They are very sad to be losing her, but decide to throw a leaving party to give her a good send-off.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.
Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish there, Peppa must find a new friend for Goldie.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre, and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a very funny puppet show.

Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep plays with Peppa. The boys don't want to play the same games as the girls, but they all agree that they like jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
When it comes to pancake making, Daddy Pig thinks he is a bit of an expert, but he has a tendency to flip the pancakes a bit too high.
George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand-new clothes. After trying on lots of new exciting outfits George finds an outfit that suits him just right!
At the park, all the leaves have turned red and yellow, and it's so windy that Peppa's ball blows into the pond and George's hat blows into a tree.
Peppa and George go ice skating, but they have never been before, and Peppa keeps falling over.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
pr.sub: Mr. Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz

pr.d: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family have been on a trip to a mountain beauty spot. When Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a drain, Mr Bull offers to find them with his digger.
While enjoying a tea break, Mr Bull accidentally breaks his delicate teapot. He takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.
pr.sub: Mr Bull in a China Shop

pr.d: Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone, so Daddy sleeps underneath the stars.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives. The donkeys take Peppa and her family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Dad to face his fear of heights.
Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Mr Bull is building. They could also find out who their new neighbours are going to be.
Peppa's car runs out of petrol, but Granddad Dog's garage is nearby, and with one call, Granddad Dog is on his way to help.
Peppa and her family follow a nature trail in the countryside, discovering footprints left by little birds and ants.
Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's Award for Industry for all the hard work she does, and Peppa and her friends will accompany her to the palace to meet the Queen.
Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. Their teacher, Madame Gazelle, is very good and was once a world champion, but in the end it is Mummy Pig who impresses everyone.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.
Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.

In einer Vision sieht Aang, dass Katara, die in Ba Sing Se zurückgeblieben ist, in großer Gefahr ist. Sofort eilt er mit Sokka und Toph zurück in die Hauptstadt des Erdkönigreichs. Unterwegs treffen sie auf einen unerwarteten Verbündeten: Iroh bietet ihnen seine Hilfe an, denn auch sein Schützling Zuko ist von Azula und den Agenten des Dai Li gefangen genommen worden. Gemeinsam dringt die kleine Truppe ins schwer bewachte Innere des Palastes vor.

Canyon Valley hosts a festival and Jack's excited to enter, until the pressure to deliver a masterpiece gets to him. When Jack and Lil are grounded by Will and Min, who are then grounded by Halmoni, the family team up to escape their punishment.
pr.sub: Canyon Valley Film Festival/ Prison Break

pr.d: Aang kommt nach der verheerenden Niederlage bei Ba Sing Se wieder zu sich. Verwundert stellt er fest, dass er sich an Bord eines Schiffes der Feuernation befindet: Seine Freunde haben es gekapert und reisen nun unter falscher Flagge. Sokkas Vater ist bereits mit den Vorbereitungen für einen Gegenschlag beschäftigt, der am Tag der Sonnenfinsternis stattfinden soll. Aang würde gern dabei helfen, muss aber erkennen, dass er noch viel zu schwach ist.

In an anthology of Halloween stories told by Mrs. Withers, Min encounters a terrifying doppelgänger, Will fends off a Toastpocalypse, Jack and Lily bury the wrong pet, and the kids get sucked into a video game.

Im Territorium der Feuernation finden Aang und seine Freunde Unterschlupf in einer Höhle. Aang verkleidet sich als Schüler, um herauszufinden, was die Kinder lernen, doch Sokka will sich lieber in der Höhle verkriechen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: On a trip to Chicago to see Gigi and Grandpa, Boss Baby comes face to face with an ambitious baby masquerading as an adult.

Aang und seine Freunde können nicht weiterfliegen, weil es Appa nicht gut geht. Sie besuchen ein Dorf am Fluss, um Medizin für den Flugbison zu besorgen. Bei den Dorfbewohnern herrscht schlechte Stimmung: Seit die Feuerarmee in der Nähe eine Fabrik errichtet hat, ist der Fluss verschmutzt, und immer mehr Menschen werden krank. Doch Besserung ist in Sicht: Nachts erscheint ein Geist, die bemalte Lady, die den armen Leuten Essen und Medizin bringt.
Sonic meets his match in Chaos Sonic, a robot version of himself designed to never fail. Meanwhile, the Chaos Council decides to expand their empire.
Sokka hat das Gefühl, nicht genug zur Gruppe beizutragen, und macht darum einen geheimnisvollen Meister des Schwertkampfs ausfindig, um bei ihm in die Lehre zu gehen.

The Thundermans are off to Hawaii for summer holiday, but there is trouble in paradise as Phoebe inadvertently has absorbed Dark Mayhem's evil powers, and now is determined to complete his plan for world domination.

Suko wird mit seiner Schwester und deren Freundinnen Mai und Ty Lee auf die Emberinsel geschickt. Da sie endlich mal wie ganz normale Jugendliche Urlaub machen wollen, geben sie sich nicht zu erkennen. Am Strand sorgen die Mädchen für großes Interesse bei den einheimischen Jungs und lösen einen regelrechten Tumult aus. Später haben die vier am Lagerfeuer Gelegenheit, sich miteinander auszusprechen und von den Problemen zu berichten, die sie bedrücken.

The Thundermans are off to Hawaii for summer holiday, but there is trouble in paradise as Phoebe inadvertently has absorbed Dark Mayhem's evil powers, and now is determined to complete his plan for world domination.
Aang und Zuko erleben gleichzeitig ein Abenteuer, das ihnen einen Einblick in die Vergangenheit ihrer Vorfahren gewährt und die Geschichte von Roku und Sozin ist eventuell für sie von Bedeutung.
Jasper's enthusiasm leads him to send Captain Man and Kid Danger into incidents that aren't crimes. When he's falsely accused and sent to jail, Henry and Ray must get him free.

Toph hat eine Idee, wie man auf schnelle Art Geld verdienen kann. Er und Sokka betrügen die Leute mit faulen Tricks. Das gefällt Katara jedoch gar nicht. Sie streiten sich und ihr Zerwürfnis hat katastrophale Konsequenzen. Aang wird von einem Unbekannten angegriffen, der die Gruppe schon seit längerer Zeit verfolgt.
When Captain Man finds himself trapped underground, Henry must devise a way to sneak out of his school's standardised testing to save Ray.

Aang und seine Freunde sind noch immer inkognito in der Feuernation unterwegs. In einem kleinen Dorf treffen sie die Wasserbändigerin Hama, die vor Jahren von Soldaten der Feuernation gefangen genommen wurde und seither hier lebt. Hama bietet Katara an, ihr eine spezielle Wasserbändiger-Technik beizubringen, die nur während des Vollmonds demonstriert werden kann. Katara ist begeistert von der Möglichkeit, ihre Kräfte weiter zu vervollkommnen, und nimmt Hamas Offerte gerne an.
The Marsupilamis are great at making music, and when a music producer hears it Jade says it was her. Lalou's cat adoption day doesn't go smoothly, when Punch is adopted by mistake.

Patrick und SpongeBob lieben das Quallenfischen, obwohl sie dabei stets erfolglos sind, nun wollen sei auch Thaddäus an dieses Hobby heranführen. Plankton hat es wieder auf die Geheimformel abgesehen und nistet sich dafür in SpongeBobs Hirn ein.

Thaddäus sorgt für Streit zwischen Patrick und SpongeBob, die jedoch plötzlich beide mit ihm befreundet sein wollen, außerdem will SpongeBob endlich seine Führerscheinprüfung bestehen und bekommt dafür Hilfe von Patrick.

Plankton entscheidet sich, statt seines Restaurants nun eine Kampfarena zu führen. Er lockt damit sogar die Gäste der Krossen Krabbe an. Thaddäus will beim Kompositionswettbewerb gewinnen, aber SpongeBob kommt ihm in die Quere.
Handy rescues Marina with a diving suit.
Gargamel clones himself to capture all one hundred Smurfs. The Smurfs unwittingly ask Dimwitty for advice when he gets stuck in a tree.
pr.sub: His Own Worst Enemy / Tree of Knowledge

pr.d: SpongeBob will gerne normal werden und trainiert dafür fleißig. Aber das hat Folgen, die nicht nur positiv sind. Seine Burger sind auf einmal auch nur noch durchschnittlich lecker. Eines Morgens sind alle Einwohner aus Bikini Bottom verschwunden.
pr.sub: Normal ist das nicht; Fort gegangen

pr.d: Handy rescues Marina with a diving suit.

After breaking Papa Smurf's telescope, Monkey wants to make up for his mistake by fetching him a star. Handy wants to assemble a team of experts to retrieve his jetpack from Gargamel, but the Smurfs he has in mind aren't available.
pr.sub: Reaching for the Stars; Dream Team

pr.d: SpongeBob hat einen Splitter in seinem Daumen und kann jetzt nicht mehr richtig arbeiten. Er will aber auf keinen Fall früher nach Hause. SpongeBob und Patrick spielen auf Lotusflöten, zu deren Klang sich alle Meerestiere bewegen müssen.

When Simon falls ill, Alvin takes his place on a camping trip only to discover it's actually an archaeological dig; the Chipmunks don't know what to do when they suspect Dave is lying about the various awards he's won.

Larry ist der Held der Goo-Lagune und lebt nach dem Motto: Lebe wild und gefährlich. SpongeBob und Patrick versuchen das auch. SpongeBob und Patrick wollen so braun werden wie Rocky Mammalton und greifen zu radikalen Mitteln.
Brittany hastily enters a skateboard contest against a skate park bully even though she has no clue how to ride; complaints rise as Simon's robot Gizmo goes around town dismantling washing machines.

Thaddäus hat Düngemittel genommen und mutiert daraufhin zum Riesen und jagt allen Angst ein. Dabei ist er doch gar kein böses Monster. Patrick möchte gern ein Riechorgan haben und lässt sich operieren. Aber das bereut er bald.
pr.sub: Thaddäus, der Riese; Eine Nase für Patrick

pr.d: SpongeBob hat eine wichtige Aufgabe: Er soll die geheime Krabbenbürger-Formel überführen. Doch der Koffer ist leer, jemand muss die Formel gestohlen haben. SpongeBob ermittelt sofort. Mr. Krabs will Planktons Stammgast für sich gewinnen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A flashback reveals everything that happened to Mega Fat between getting fired from Baby Corp and getting adopted by a well-known journalist.

SpongeBob und Patrick machen ein Freundschaftsquiz, bei dem Patrick sehr schlecht abschneidet, SpongeBob ist natürlich schwer enttäuscht und leidet sehr. Und: SpongeBob und Perla hängen gemeinsam im Boot eines Vergnügungsparks fest.
pr.sub: Von Tuten und Schwamm keine Ahnung; Im Fingerling der Liebe

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Halloween is the perfect cover for the Boss Baby and his costumed field team to sneak into the belly of the beast, but Staci concocts plans to stop them.
Dora, Boots und Vicky suchen magische Instrumente. Dora rettet eine besondere Bananen-Handpuppe.
pr.sub: Wo sind die magischen Instrumente? / Herrn Bananes Großes Puppentheater

pr.d: Rock is bad at keeping secrets, so when he learns one that will devastate Paper, he goes to great lengths to keep it from him. Sandpaper is disappointed the trio is playing video games all day, so she signs them up for her personal workout program.

Tim, Tommy, Tia und Oma begeben sich gemeinsam auf eine Schatzsuche. Es ist endlich an der Zeit für das Brüll-Festival und Tim möchte das beste Gebrüll der Stadt haben. Tim, Tommy und Tia finden ein Mammut bei sich zu Hause.
pr.sub: Der Schatz / Mit Gebrüll! / Das Mammut

pr.d: When the Stars go to the drive-in movie theatre, the family splits up and causes chaos in every possible place. After a Time Closet mix-up, Patrick and Cave Pat switch places.
pr.sub: DRIVE-IN ME CRAZY/A STONE AGE STAR IS BORN

pr.d: 1. Geschichte: Lynn entdeckt durch Zufall, dass der Nachbar der Familie, Mr. Grouse mindestens genauso gerne Sportsendungen schaut wie sie. Aus diesem Grund tun sie sich zusammen und sehen nun gemeinsam Sportsendungen. 2. Geschichte: Lisa ist fest entschlossen, das Leben ihres Opas zu verlängern. Deshalb fängt sie an, wissenschaftlich zu nachzuforschen.

Plankton travels two thousand years into the future and finds a few unfamiliar faces. SpongeBob, Patrick, and Sandy find themselves in the middle of a long-standing feud between the Narwhals and the Planktons.
pr.sub: PL-1413; In the Mood to Feud

pr.d: 1. Geschichte: Da Clyde sich als Einzelkind von seinen überbesorgten Vätern zu eingeengt fühlt, bietet er einem Austauschschüler an, für einige Zeit bei ihnen zu wohnen. 2. Geschichte: Lola hilft einer unsicheren Schülerin dabei, beliebter zu werden.

Jeanette and the Chipmunks orchestrate a break-in at Bocarter's house to rescue a chimpanzee he keeps in a cage. Alvin is alarmed that Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes because he's not that funny.
Patrick und Großvater versuchen, einander auf der Treppe zu überholen, was zu einem Konflikt führt.
The pals search for the culprit who nabbed a crab's spiral shell home; Sweetie the honey badger sneaks into Sam and Kit's bee-infested aircraft.
pr.sub: The Case of the Blue Bandit; The Honey Badger Break-In

pr.d: Patrick verliert die Fernbedienung zwischen den Kissen und begibt sich auf eine Reise ins Innere des Sofas, um sie zu finden. Zudem veranstaltet Patrick einen Spendenmarathon, um Geld für Schnecken zu sammeln, die nicht tanzen können.
The whole city is hunting critters on their phones. The Marsups even play on Gran Gran's phone. Mica believes that Marcel is interested in astronomy so befriends him!
pr.sub: Critter Capture Quest; Mica's unlikely Bestie

pr.d: Nachdem er von einigen exzentrischen Feiertagen wie dem Steintag gehört hat, möchte Paper seinen eigenen Feiertag einführen. Scissors muss sich genau überlegen, ob er seinen Mitbewohnern beim Einkaufen helfen will.

Schere verkauft sein Konterfei blindlings an eine neue Firma, die Windeln für Babys verkauft. Stein versucht, Papier und Schere davon zu überzeugen, dass er bereit für ein Haustier ist, indem er sich um einen tödlichen Roboterhund kümmert.
The Gabby Cats need to make a special art project for Baby Box's Meow-Seum Day; with many different ways to make art, who knows what they'll create.

Die Mütter von SpongeBob, Herrn Krabs und Okto besuchen die Krosse Krabbe und übernehmen prompt die Leitung, was dazu führt, dass die Crew faul wird. Patrick ist auf der Suche nach einem Haustier und findet den Stein seiner Träume.
Bubble goes on an adventure with Firefly. Gargamel creates a switch that can turn off all the lights so that he can find the Smurf village.

Plankton und Karen nehmen gemeinsam Tanzstunden und werden schnell die Besten im Kurs. SpongeBob findet ein Zauberbuch, welches für reichlich Chaos sorgt. Denn er nutzt dieses, um in der Küche der Krossen Krabbe verschiedenes zu kochen.
pr.sub: Tango-Revanche / Frühstück in der Krossen Krabbe

pr.d: Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle over popping acorn tops and bubble wrap. When a cute girl joins the chess club, Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him how to play so he can join as well.

SpongeBob und Patrick sind begeistert von einem Spielzeug, das das Gehirn zum Fliegen bringt. SpongeBob und Patrick geben vor, ihre liebsten Superhelden Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarsch-Bube zu sein. Doch dann tauchen deren Erzfeinde auf.
After learning about the Knights of the Round Table, Theodore wants to be a knight and struggles to do good deeds. Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes.

Sandy, Mr. Krabs und Patrick bitten SpongeBob darum, ihnen einige Gefallen zu tun. Diese kann SpongeBob nicht einfach so abschlagen. Aber unglücklicherweise wollen alle drei gleichzeitig etwas von ihm. Das erschwert die Situation für SpongeBob.

Carls Leidenschaft für Spielzeuge verleitet ihn zur Karriere als Spielzeugtester. Fridas Kunst wird von jemandem schlecht bewertet. Daraufhin versuchen die Kinder, eine neue Auktion zu veranstalten, um ihre Stimmung zu heben.

Scissors makes it a flat rule to be hardcore, and Paper struggles to follow it. Scissors' therapist is on holiday as Logan the Rat Bro starts bullying him for figure skating, so she refers him to her colleague, Logan.

Hektor wird in seine Lieblingsfußballmannschaft aufgenommen - als Maskottchen, das Glück bringen soll. Sid und Adelaide backen Baos für das chinesische Kulturfest, da bekommen sie es mit Banditen zu tun, die durch die Zeit reisen.

Rock, Paper and Scissors crash into Hollywood actor Henry Winkler's house, and they all go on a wacky adventure together. While trying to woo Pencil, Paper mistakenly ends up in a relationship he doesn't want with Potato.
pr.sub: The Henry Winkler Episode; Paper Loves Potato

pr.d: Clyde beschließt, eine Kochschule in Frankreich zu besuchen, doch seine Freunde wollen ihn nicht dorthin gehen lassen. Währenddessen wollen Lola und Lena das neue Zwillingswerbepaar von Tante Pam auswählen und suchen dafür Cheryl und Meryl aus.

Lil's favourite boba shop is closing! The kids try to save the café using pucker limes, but are quickly forced to save Canyon Valley from the pucker. Lil and Min both realize how similar they are to their mums and set out to distinguish themselves.
pr.sub: The Boba--Get; Be Your Own Bean

pr.d: Die Herrie-Kinder helfen Flip dabei, sein Date mit Kami zu einem Erfolg zu machen. Außerdem unterstützen Lucy und ihre Freunde den Nachbarn Grauw dabei, einen Geist zu verjagen. Als Belohnung für ihre Hilfe erhalten sie Geld.
While Nine reassembles the Paradox Prism, Shadow and Sonic battle the Council to buy more time - but there's one big surprise they weren't counting on.

Lincoln und Clyde schmieden große Pläne für ihre Frühlingsferien, doch es kommt alles anders als gedacht. Lori plant eine Geburtstagsfeier mit Niveau. Das ist in ihrem Haus aber ziemlich schwierig, wie sich bald herausstellt.

Während Patrick versucht, ein Spezial-Sandwich zu bestellen, wird er plötzlich weggeschwemmt und landet in der toughen Businesswelt. Thaddäus bekommt eine Einladung zu einer Galerie-Eröffnung und hat Probleme, eine Plus-Eins zu finden.
After getting detention again, Alvin's convinced Dave will drive him to the desert and abandon him there; Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences.

Mr. Krabs veranstaltet ein Firmen-Picknick, um den Zusammenhalt zu stärken. Doch auch Plankton veranstaltet am selben Tag ein Picknick. Mr. Krabs erzählt SpongeBob alte Geschichten aus seiner Zeit bei der Navy.

When the boys get stuck with Miss Miller as a babysitter, they each take a crack at finding a replacement. Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.
SpongeBob entdeckt eine streunende Katze in Bikini Bottom und beschließt, auf sie aufzupassen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A flashback reveals everything that happened to Mega Fat between getting fired from Baby Corp and getting adopted by a well-known journalist.

Schere, Stein und Papier versuchen, ihre Tradition aufrechtzuerhalten, jeden Moonami-Film am Premierentag zu sehen. Das Trio landet vor einem Spinnenrichter und einer Jury, weil es versucht hat, eine Spinne in seiner Wohnung zu zerquetschen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Halloween is the perfect cover for the Boss Baby and his costumed field team to sneak into the belly of the beast, but Staci concocts plans to stop them.
Blubberbernd kritisiert die Patrick Show und Bunny nimmt Patrick mit zur Arbeit im Gefängnis.

Pinkys Eltern sind sehr beschäftigt und Pinky möchte, dass sie sich endlich wieder näherkommen. Damit dies auch gelingt, schmiedet er den ausgeklügelten Plan, ein besonderes romantisches Abendessen für sie zu organisieren.

Rock, Paper and Scissors crash into Hollywood actor Henry Winkler's house, and they all go on a wacky adventure together. While trying to woo Pencil, Paper mistakenly ends up in a relationship he doesn't want with Potato.
pr.sub: The Henry Winkler Episode; Paper Loves Potato

pr.d: Der Club muss die Schulbelegschaft davon abhalten, Cupcakes zu essen, die sie in einen Kobold verwandeln. // Leni macht ein Praktikum bei Mariella Moss. Aber Lenis Freund demonstriert gegen ihre neue Kollektion.
When the Stars go to the drive-in movie theatre, the family splits up and causes chaos in every possible place. After a Time Closet mix-up, Patrick and Cave Pat switch places.
pr.sub: DRIVE-IN ME CRAZY/A STONE AGE STAR IS BORN

pr.d: Als Mama und die Zwillinge in der Lotterie einen Wochenendausflug gewinnen, fällt es Lana schwer, ihre Tiere einfach so zurückzulassen. Nachdem Lincoln einen Zaubertrick an Nachbar Gray ausprobiert hat, sitzen sie zusammen fest.
Two familiar faces from SpongeBob's past visit; Plankton finds an unlikely ally in the sewers.
